component.name: RGDSCapture
component.summary: Software capture card for the Anbernic RG Dual Screen

description.p: RGDSCapture turns an Anbernic RG Dual Screen into a capture source with no capture hardware. It connects to the device over SSH, starts H.264 pipelines on it, and receives both screens as low-latency RTP streams.
Audio is monitored from the console's headphone jack through your PC's line input, which keeps the network path video-only and the video stable.

ul.li: Both screens live, in five arrangements including a melonDS-style hybrid
Record either screen, or both stacked with audio, straight to MP4 with no re-encoding
Instant replay buffer, savable as MP4 or GIF
Line-in passthrough with drift correction and stereo level meters
A speedrun timer with lap splits
50 themes, a custom accent picker, and UI scaling from 80% to 175%

description.p: First Linux release: the interface is rebuilt on Avalonia, audio runs through PipeWire or PulseAudio, and saved passwords go to the desktop keyring.
